description: Gul Ahmed Textile Mills Limited began manufacturing in 1953 and has been listed on the Karachi Stock Exchange since 1970; it describes itself as a composite unit making everything from cotton yarn to finished products. It runs more than 51,840 spindles, 300 weaving machines and yarn dyeing, processing and stitching units, with a captive power plant of gas engines, gas and steam turbines and backup diesel engines, and a wastewater treatment plant. The company also operates the Ideas by Gul Ahmed retail chain of more than 40 stores, and lists Ideas (Private) Limited and Gul Ahmed International Limited (FZC), UAE as wholly owned subsidiaries.
